lines.en: Shuffle forward slowly
Move slowly to avoid enemies
Chomp on rotten meat
Lick the ground for food

lines.zh: 我弓着背，一步步蹭向巷口。
lines.en: Hunched over, I shuffle toward the alley mouth.
Limp closer to the player
Feet dragging, looking for a meal.
Hunger makes me sluggish
Scrabbles forward

lines.zh: 缓慢地移动以靠近目标
lines.en: Move slowly to approach the target
I drag one foot forward
Skin hangs loose on my bones
Fade in the corner
Bite at something on the ground
Shake its head idly

lines.zh: 腐烂的皮肉在风中飘动
lines.en: Skin flaps in the wind
Stare into the distance
Creep slowly

lines.zh: 我在垃圾桶后面站了很久。
lines.en: I have stood behind the trash bins a long while.

lines.zh: 腐烂的肢体无规律颤动
lines.en: Decaying limbs twitch
Decaying blood oozes out
Move limbs aimlessly

lines.zh: 你把瓶子踢响，我的头抬起来。
lines.en: You kick a bottle; my head comes up.
Gaze fixed on the target
Slowly turn its head
Stares at the player for a while
Struggles to see the player

lines.zh: 我缓慢转头，颈骨咔了一声。
lines.en: I turn my head slowly and my neck clicks.
Slowly turns to look for the player
Struggles to understand the player

lines.zh: 喉咙里的声音憋不住了
lines.en: The sound in my throat won't stay down
Focuses on the target

lines.zh: 我的胳膊上，咬痕还在渗。
lines.en: The bite mark on my arm still seeps.
Leg broken, can't walk.

lines.zh: 我捂着肚子，肠子缠在手上。
lines.en: I clutch my belly, intestines wrapped round my hand.
That patch on my leg has gone rotten.
Too weak to move.

lines.zh: 快点找药，否则就死定了。
lines.en: Find a cure or you're dead.
Wound won't heal.

lines.zh: 我舔着地上的水，还是饿。
lines.en: I lick water off the ground and am still hungry.
Too cold, find shelter.
Too weak to stand.

lines.zh: 骷髅头散发冷光，吸引猎物靠近。
lines.en: The skull glows cold, drawing prey closer.

lines.zh: 你闻到腐肉的味道了吗？
lines.en: Can you smell the rotting flesh?

lines.zh: 你快点过来，这里的食物很香。
lines.en: Come over here, the food is delicious.

lines.zh: 咬我一口，感受末日的滋味。
lines.en: Give me a bite, taste the end.

lines.zh: 腐肉的滋味，你值得拥有。
lines.en: The taste of rot, it's yours now.
Why don't you bite me?

lines.zh: 你已经被腐化了，尝尝吧。
lines.en: You are already corrupted, taste it.

lines.zh: 靠近我，享受末世的馈赠。
lines.en: Come closer, enjoy the offering of the end.

lines.zh: 你迟早会成为我的同类。
lines.en: You'll become like me eventually.

lines.zh: 这里的食物最鲜美，尝尝吧。
lines.en: This food is the freshest, taste it.

lines.zh: 你挡了我的路，准备好战斗吧。
lines.en: You're in my way, prepare to fight.
Get out of my way, or you're dead.

lines.zh: 你试图伤害我，这只会加速你的死亡。
lines.en: You tried to harm me, that only speeds up your death.
You're too close, back off!

lines.zh: 你触碰了我的领地，战斗吧。
lines.en: You've trespassed my territory, fight me.

lines.zh: 别挡我，否则你会受到攻击。
lines.en: Don't block my path, you'll be attacked.

lines.zh: 烂掉的手抬起来，抓向你。
lines.en: A rotting hand rises toward you.

lines.zh: 离我远点，不然你也会变成这样。
lines.en: Stay back, or you'll become like me.

lines.zh: 你挡住了我的去路，必须解决你。
lines.en: You blocked my path, I must deal with you.

lines.zh: 你离我太近，我必须保护自己。
lines.en: You're too close, I must protect myself.

lines.zh: 找一个伴侣，我们的种族才能延续。
lines.en: Find a mate, our species can continue.

lines.zh: 你适合做我的配偶，跟我来。
lines.en: You're suitable as a mate, follow me.

lines.zh: 找到一个伴侣，共同抵御末日。
lines.en: Find a mate, we can face the end together.

lines.zh: 你看起来很健康，适合做配偶。
lines.en: You look healthy, you're a good mate.

lines.zh: 找到一个健康的伴侣，我们的种族才能延续。
lines.en: Find a healthy mate, our species can continue.

lines.zh: 我需要一个健康的伴侣，跟我来。
lines.en: I need a healthy mate, follow me.

lines.zh: 你看起来强壮，适合做我的配偶。
lines.en: You look strong, you're a good mate.

lines.zh: 和我一起，我们的力量更强。
lines.en: Join me, we are stronger together.

lines.zh: 我们共同抵御末日，找一个伴侣。
lines.en: Face the end together, find a mate.

lines.zh: 你需要一个伴侣，我来帮助你。
lines.en: You need a mate, I'll help you.
Rusty bones creak

lines.zh: 干瘪的皮肤发出嘎吱声
lines.en: Dried skin creaks
Decaying flesh drips blood
Dry knuckles creak

lines.zh: 碎裂的骨头发出咔嗒声
lines.en: Broken bones click

lines.zh: 腐烂的手指紧紧抓住你
lines.en: Finger bones clutch you

lines.zh: 干瘪的手掌覆盖着血污
lines.en: Bloodstained palms
Skin splits, blood flows
Dry fingers reach for you

lines.zh: 腐烂的指甲刺入你的皮肤
lines.en: Decayed nails pierce your skin
Hungry eyes on you
Dry lips move
Taut, dry flesh
Decaying muscles twist
Dry teeth appear
Dry cheeks taut

lines.zh: 干枯的喉咙发出嘶嘶声
lines.en: Dry throat hisses

lines.zh: 我闻到你背包里有罐头。
lines.en: I smell canned food in your pack.
Dry cheeks slacken
Dry lips close tight
Someone is still moving out there
I smell the warmth of the living
He has not been bitten yet
Breathing, over there
My teeth have started to itch
Flesh rots around you
Blood drips on you
Putrid smell spreads
Dry fingers grasp you
Decaying arms swing
The stench reaches you before I do.
My knuckles scrape along the wall as I come.
Dry palms cover you
Decaying teeth bite
Dry lips move
I shuffle slowly toward him
My leg is broken. I will crawl
I do not shout. I just follow
He is backing against a wall
Around this way is shorter
My fingers have reached him
He cannot run any further
One bite is all it takes

lines.zh: 发出沉重的嘶吼，用腐烂的手臂攻击！
lines.en: Rippling with putrefaction, lunge with decayed arms!
Decayed arms swinging at you!

lines.zh: 痛苦的嘶叫，试图拉扯你！
lines.en: Pained wail, trying to tear you apart!

lines.zh: 用腐烂的手臂紧紧抱住你！
lines.en: Clutching you with decayed arms!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中，腐烂的手臂抓住你！
lines.en: Decayed arms grab you with a hiss!

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，试图咬破你的皮肉！
lines.en: Snarling, trying to bite through your flesh!

lines.zh: 腐烂的肢体紧紧缠住你！
lines.en: Decaying limbs clinging to you!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中，腐烂的手臂拉扯你！
lines.en: Decayed arms pulling you with a hiss!

lines.zh: 腐烂的手臂迅速攻击你的喉咙！
lines.en: Decayed arms lunging for your throat!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中，腐烂的手臂试图咬你！
lines.en: Decayed arms biting you with a hiss!
I bite into his arm
Blood seeps between my teeth
He shoves me off. I grab again
My nails rake open his back
I pin him on the rubble
The wound will start to bleed

lines.zh: 从黑暗中缓缓爬出，寻找猎物！
lines.en: Emerging from the dark, seeking prey!
Crawling out, wandering around!

lines.zh: 在腐烂的土地上缓慢移动！
lines.en: Moving slowly on the decaying ground!

lines.zh: 在废墟中寻找新的宿主！
lines.en: Scouring ruins for new hosts!

lines.zh: 在夜晚中悄悄出现，寻找目标！
lines.en: Appearing in the night, seeking a target!
Surging from the ground, searching around!

lines.zh: 在阴影中悄悄移动，寻找猎物！
lines.en: Creeping in the shadows, seeking prey!

lines.zh: 在腐烂的树枝上缓缓爬行！
lines.en: Crawling slowly on rotting branches!

lines.zh: 在废墟中缓慢游荡，寻找猎物！
lines.en: Wandering through ruins, seeking prey!

lines.zh: 从地下缓缓爬出，寻找下一个目标！
lines.en: Crawling out of the ground, seeking the next victim!
Under the rubble, something turns over
I rise out of the debris
The heat is gone. I still walk
This body moves again

lines.zh: 火苗爬过我的烂皮，缩起来。
lines.en: Flames crawl over my rotten skin and it shrinks.
Fell and broke my leg.

lines.zh: 水里浮不起来，一直往下沉。
lines.en: I can't float; I keep sinking.
Hit by an explosion.
Hit by an arrow.
Cursed, find a way to break it.
My belly echoes with emptiness.

lines.zh: 雷把我劈得倒在水泥地上。
lines.en: Lightning knocks me flat onto the concrete.
Died in the Nether.
